record.paper_title: Basic Properties of Strong Mixing Conditions. A Survey and Some Open Questions
record.original_question: Given an arbitrary nonincreasing sequence (b_n) of numbers in [0,1], does there exist a strictly stationary random sequence X = (X_k, k ∈ Z) whose phi-mixing coefficients satisfy phi(n) = b_n for every n ≥ 1? In other words, can an arbitrary prescribed nonincreasing phi-mixing rate be realized exactly, not just up to a small error window?

evidence.quote: Question 7 : Suppose (b_1, b_2, b_3, . . .) is an arbitrary nonincreasing sequence of numbers in [0, 1]. Does there exist a strictly stationary random sequence X := (X_k, k ∈ Z) such that for all n ≥ 1, φ(n) = b_n?
In the strictly stationary φ-mixing constructions ... there is an arbitrarily small 'window' or 'error' in the specification of the dependence coefficients φ(n).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X = (X_k)_{k ∈ Z} be a strictly stationary sequence of random variables on a probability space (Ω, F, P). For −∞ ≤ J ≤ L ≤ ∞, let F_J^L denote the σ-algebra generated by {X_k : J ≤ k ≤ L, k ∈ Z}. For each integer n ≥ 1, define the φ-mixing coefficient

  φ(n) = sup { |P(B | A) − P(B)| : A ∈ F_{−∞}^0, B ∈ F_n^∞, P(A) > 0 }.

The sequence (φ(n))_{n ≥ 1} is automatically nonincreasing and takes values in [0, 1].

Question: Given an arbitrary nonincreasing sequence (b_n)_{n ≥ 1} of numbers in [0, 1], does there exist a strictly stationary random sequence X = (X_k)_{k ∈ Z} whose φ-mixing coefficients satisfy

  φ(n) = b_n for every n ≥ 1

(exactly, with no "window" or error tolerance)?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in Bradley's 2005 survey on strong mixing conditions as an explicitly stated open question (Question 7). Existing constructions of strictly stationary φ-mixing sequences only achieve prescribed rates up to an arbitrarily small error window. No subsequent literature found in the search establishes exact realization of an arbitrary nonincreasing [0,1]-valued sequence as the φ-mixing coefficients of a strictly stationary process, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Basic Properties of Strong Mixing Conditions. A Survey and Some Open Questions
status_evidence.snippet: Survey lists open questions concerning strong mixing conditions including exact realization of φ-mixing rates.
status_evidence.claim: Question on exact realization of φ-mixing coefficients is posed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Strong mixing conditions - Encyclopedia of Mathematics
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses φ-mixing constructions with arbitrarily small windows in prescribed dependence coefficients.
status_evidence.claim: Known constructions only achieve prescribed φ(n) up to an error window, not exactly.
